scope: Diagnostic XNU entry probe with BCM-only MMIO suppressed and early exception display; no device action
success_requires: PROBE28: mount and first exec continue; side panel IDs220..238 observe native activation/task switch/signature/cleanup. A02D activation errno, A02E signature errno, A02F task switch observed, A030 actual exec return, A032 MAC entry errno; stage-specific fields overwrite old WFE data. ID239 magenta/A02B239 means unreviewed restore task release held, not execution success. Original errors/panic/fallback retained; zero activation alone is not success. Revision33 always renders actual activation/exec/signature post-call values, retains last completed error across fallback; A02C counts init exec attempts. No new endpoint. IDs240..263=exec and dyld calls/continuations. A02E=first nonzero stage call ID per attempt, A032=its raw native return (errno or Mach loader status according to callee), A02C=attempt count. Aggregate activation/exec remain A02D/A030. No forced success or path substitution. Before real init exec, request normal Zlib OSKext lifecycle only when native type4 registration is absent; no direct kmod start or table writes. IDs264/265 observe loading; A02A=actual loader status, A033=actual native type4 registration pointer. All successful stages continue; restore userspace release guard remains. Header call 250 resets row y784 x832..1295. IDs266/267=vn_rdwr_64 call/return, 268/269=MAC read, 270/271=VNOP_READ, 272/273=actual filesystem dispatch, 274/275=swap-file read. Scope requires this exact header caller, TPIDR_EL1 and native frame; return markers require their paired call. A034=last read stage; A035=actual low32 return, all ones while call is pending. These overwrite prior A034/A035 after header entry. No marker proves APFS/decmpfs body completion unless its matching return was observed. Real errors and release guard retained.
